title: National Partnership Emails — 2017
notes: Women Serving in Ministry is the dominant issue in this archive.
Kessler explicitly calls Irwyn Ince an NP member and committee chairman before circulating Ince's private strategic explanation of the study committee report.
The archive records active support for Alexander Jun for Moderator but does not by that fact establish Jun as an NP member.
The archive also records concern with overtures limiting the Cooperative Ministries Committee and ad-interim committee formation.

key_evidence_locations.description: Irwyn Ince explicitly called NP member and chairman of WIM Study Committee
Ince explains consensus strategy and desire to move broader women-in-ministry conversation forward
Ince says recommendations call sessions/presbyteries to appoint gifted women to assist elders, including women gifted in shepherding
Kessler endorses Alexander Jun for Moderator and describes importance of moderator/CMC role
